URLHandler.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the instance by assigning the provided url argument to the instance attribute self.url." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> url </REF>: string "The URL value to assign to the instance attribute."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the value of parameter url to instance attribute self.url. RESULT self.url]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
URLHandler.get_scheme:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extract and return the URL scheme prefix before the first '://' separator in self.url, or return None if no such separator exists." get_scheme]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> scheme </REF>: string or None "The URL scheme substring before '://' when the separator exists; otherwise None."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Find the lowest index of the substring "://" in self.url, returning -1 if the substring is absent, and assign that index to scheme_end. RESULT scheme_end]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: scheme_end is not equal to -1]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the substring self.url[:scheme_end]. RESULT scheme]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: scheme_end is equal to -1]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None. RESULT scheme]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
URLHandler.get_host:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extracts the host/authority portion from a URL string after removing the scheme delimiter '://' and before the first following slash, returning None when no scheme delimiter is found." get_host]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: string|null "The extracted host/authority substring, or None when no scheme delimiter is present in self.url."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compute scheme_end as the lowest starting index of "://" in self.url, returning -1 when the delimiter is not found. RESULT scheme_end]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If scheme_end is not equal to -1, meaning a scheme delimiter was found in self.url.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Within the outer if scheme_end != -1 branch, compute url_without_scheme as the substring of self.url from index scheme_end + 3 to the end. RESULT url_without_scheme]
            [COMMAND Within the outer if scheme_end != -1 branch, compute host_end as the lowest starting index of "/" in url_without_scheme, or -1 if no slash is present. RESULT host_end]
            [COMMAND Within the outer if scheme_end != -1 branch, if host_end is not equal to -1, return the substring url_without_scheme from index 0 up to but excluding host_end. RESULT return_value]
            [COMMAND Within the outer if scheme_end != -1 branch, if host_end is equal to -1, return the entire url_without_scheme. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If scheme_end is equal to -1, meaning no scheme delimiter was found in self.url.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
URLHandler.get_path:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extracts and returns the URL suffix starting at the first slash after the scheme and authority, or returns None when no scheme delimiter or no such slash is found." get_path]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: string|null "The substring from the first slash after the URL scheme and authority to the end of the URL, or None if no scheme delimiter or no such slash exists."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Find the lowest index of the literal substring "://" in self.url and store the result in scheme_end; if the substring is absent, store -1. RESULT scheme_end]
            [COMMAND If scheme_end is not equal to -1, extract the substring of self.url from index scheme_end + 3 to the end and store it in url_without_scheme. RESULT url_without_scheme]
            [COMMAND Within the outer if branch where scheme_end is not equal to -1, find the lowest index of the literal substring "/" in url_without_scheme and store the result in host_end; if absent, store -1. RESULT host_end]
            [COMMAND Within the nested if branch where scheme_end is not equal to -1 and host_end is not equal to -1, return the substring of url_without_scheme from host_end to the end as the method result. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: scheme_end equals -1 after searching for "://" in self.url, meaning no scheme delimiter is present.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None as the method result. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: scheme_end is not equal to -1 but host_end equals -1 after searching for "/" in url_without_scheme, meaning no slash exists after the scheme and authority.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None as the method result. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
URLHandler.get_query_params:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Parse the URL query string into a dictionary of key-value parameters, returning an empty dictionary for an empty query and None when the URL has no '?' marker." get_query_params]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> params </REF>: dict "Parsed query parameters as a dictionary. Duplicate keys are overwritten by later occurrences. Pairs without exactly one '=' are ignored. An empty query string returns an empty dictionary."
        <REF> none </REF>: None "Returned when the URL has no '?' query marker."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set query_start to the lowest index of the "?" character in self.url, or set it to -1 if "?" is not present. RESULT query_start]
            [COMMAND Set fragment_start to the lowest index of the "#" character in self.url, or set it to -1 if "#" is not present. RESULT fragment_start]
            [COMMAND If query_start is not -1, extract query_string as self.url[query_start + 1:fragment_start]; when fragment_start is -1, the slice stops before the last character of self.url. RESULT query_string]
            [COMMAND Within the if query_start != -1 branch, initialize params as an empty dictionary. RESULT params]
            [COMMAND Within the if query_start != -1 branch, if len(query_string) is greater than 0, split query_string by "&" into param_pairs. RESULT param_pairs]
            [COMMAND Within the if query_start != -1 branch and the nested if len(query_string) > 0 branch, for each pair in param_pairs, split pair by "=" into key_value. RESULT key_value]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over param_pairs, if len(key_value) equals 2, unpack key and value from key_value and assign params[key] = value. RESULT params]
            [COMMAND Within the if query_start != -1 branch, after the nested len(query_string) > 0 check and loop, return params. RESULT params]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: query_start equals -1]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None. RESULT none]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
URLHandler.get_fragment:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Extracts and returns the URL fragment substring after the first '#' delimiter, or None if no '#' delimiter is present." get_fragment]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> fragment </REF>: string_or_null "The URL fragment substring after the first '#' delimiter, or None if no '#' delimiter is present."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Find the index of the first occurrence of the '#' delimiter in self.url and assign it to fragment_start. RESULT fragment_start]
            [COMMAND If fragment_start is not -1, return the substring of self.url starting at fragment_start + 1 through the end of the string. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: fragment_start equals -1, meaning self.url does not contain the '#' delimiter.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None. RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
